The script confirmed that $V(100) = 14$, which perfectly matches the formula $V(n) = k + (1 \text{ if } (n-4)\%7 \in \{1,3,5\} \text{ else } 2)$ with $k = (n-4)//7$. Applying this to $n=2020$ gives $V(2020) = 290$.
